struct MaxFlow {
    struct Edge {
        int from, to;
        ll flow, capacity;
    };
    
    int start, end_point;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<int> graph[MAX_SIZE];
    int distance[MAX_SIZE], visited[MAX_SIZE], current[MAX_SIZE];

    void initialize() {
        edges.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            graph[i].clear();
        }
    }

    void add_edge(int from, int to, ll cap) {
        Edge e1 = {from, to, 0LL, cap};
        Edge e2 = {to, from, 0LL, 0LL};
        edges.push_back(e1);
        edges.push_back(e2);
        graph[from].push_back((int)edges.size() - 2);
        graph[to].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
    }

    bool build_level_graph() {
        memset(visited, 0, sizeof(visited));
        memset(distance, 0, sizeof(distance));
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(start);
        visited[start] = 1;
        distance[start] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[v].size(); i++) {
                Edge &e = edges[graph[v][i]];
                int nxt = e.to;
                if (!visited[nxt] && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    distance[nxt] = distance[v] + 1;
                    q.push(nxt);
                    visited[nxt] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visited[end_point];
    }

    ll send_flow(int v, ll flow) {
        if (v == end_point || flow == 0) return flow;
        ll total_flow = 0;
        for (int &i = current[v]; i < (int)graph[v].size(); i++) {
            Edge &e = edges[graph[v][i]];
            if (distance[v] + 1 == distance[e.to]) {
                ll min_cap = min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow);
                ll pushed = send_flow(e.to, min_cap);
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    edges[graph[v][i] ^ 1].flow -= pushed;
                    total_flow += pushed;
                    flow -= pushed;
                    if (flow == 0) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    ll max_flow() {
        ll total = 0;
        while (build_level_graph()) {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) current[i] = 0;
            total += send_flow(start, INF);
        }
        return total;
    }
};

            if (grid1[i][j] >= '0' && grid1[i][j] <= '9')
